ModMetaData.name: Colony Command
ModMetaData.author: jtj9817
ModMetaData.description:
Find colonists without leaving the map. Colony Command adds a panel to the vanilla colonist bar for searching, filtering and sorting your roster.
- Search by name. - Filter by Drafted, Injured, Idle or Inspired status. - Filter by skill and minimum level. - Sort by name, mood or the selected skill, or restore vanilla order. - Reset the controls to show the original bar.
The panel sits below the Learning Helper and folds into a compact menu when space is limited. Filters and sorting only change the displayed view; they do not change colonists or their saved order. UI state is not saved and resets when a game is loaded.
Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Core only. No DLC or other mods are required. Can be added to or removed from an existing save.
